channel.title: Trinidad and Tobago Newsday - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Trinidad and Tobago Newsday (newsday.co.tt)

item.title: Final salute to Newsday - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: THERESE MILLS. Hers is the name many will remember first when they think of Newsday. She had already broken a glass ceiling, as the first woman to be editor in chief of a national daily newspaper. Then she took on a new assignment: founding editor in chief of Newsday, in 1993.

item.title: Holding parents accountable when children offend - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: The Government has signalled its intention to introduce legislation to hold parents legally accountable when their children are in conflict with the law, particularly in relation to bullying, violence and related misconduct affecting schools and communities.

item.title: AG: Trinidad and Tobago not a zone of peace - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: ATTORNEY General John Jeremie says Trinidad and Tobago has been grappling with “rampant” gang-related violent crime for more than a decade, telling a regional forum that the country is not “a zone of peace.”

item.title: PM knocks poor work ethic at regional corporations - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: PRIME Minister Kamla Persad-Bissessar is warning regional corporations they will not receive any additional state funding, and will only receive more in the next budget if service delivery is improved over the next eight months.

item.title: Energy Ministry: Block TTUD-1 seismic survey among largest in TT - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: MINISTER of Energy and Energy Industries Dr Roodal Moonilal, Minister in the Ministry of Energy Ernesto Kesar, and Saddam Hosein, Minister of Land and Legal Affairs with responsibility for the Chaguaramas Development Authority, on January 23 toured the Amazon Warrior, a research and survey vessel attached to the Shearwater GeoServices seismic fleet.

item.title: PNM to honour stalwarts at 70th anniversary celebration - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: SEVERAL People’s National Movement (PNM) stalwarts are expected to be honoured during the party’s 70th anniversary celebration on January 26 at Queen’s Hall, Port of Spain.

item.title: CSO on the ground to get data for census - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: THE Central Statistical Office (CSO) of the Ministry of Planning, Economic Affairs, and Development is beginning a nationwide geospatial data update exercise (GDUE) on January 26, as part of preparations for the upcoming Population and Housing Census.

item.title: PNM to open nominations for local government elections - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: THE People's National Movement (PNM) has issued a call for nominations ahead of local government elections.

item.title: UNC celebrates 16 years of Kamla's leadership - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: THE United National Congress (UNC) celebrated 16 years of leadership by Prime Minister Kamla Persad-Bissessar in a January 25 press release. It was issued on a parliamentary letterhead from the Minister of the People, Social Development and Family Services Vandana Mohit.

item.title: UAE delegation visits Tobago - Trinidad and Tobago Newsday
item.description: CHIEF SECRETARY Farley Augustine has welcomed a delegation from the United Arab Emirates (UAE), led by Noura bint Mohammed Al Kaabi, Minister of State in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to Tobago.
